scope: Actual shell, production Workspace reads and temporary SQLite; synthetic images. Video case proves DOM release only, not decoding/performance.

checks.expectation: An unchanged forced refresh reuses the card
An unchanged forced refresh reuses the image
A focused checkbox survives the refresh
Another asset changing leaves this card and focus intact
Metadata updates do not replace the unchanged source image
Labels, tags and saved review update as text
Metadata updates retain the original favorite control
Checkbox and selected styling match the owned selection
Insertions preserve existing card, image and focused control
Rendered order follows the current library order
Reordering preserves node identity and keyboard focus
Reordering still matches the selected sort
A removed focused card moves focus to the next surviving checkbox
A removed card leaves no stale grid node
Unchanged empty view retains its focused recovery action
No surviving cards returns grid focus to Search
A refresh does not steal focus from another control
A changed source replaces only the preview, not card controls
A different Workspace never reuses coincident card identities
A removed video is paused and detached from its source
Refreshing beneath a dialog preserves focused unsaved notes
Reused controls retain their delegated selection behavior
Clear selection immediately after a checkbox click clears its visual state
An unchanged refresh makes no grid DOM mutations
The insertBefore fallback retains the focused control on reorder
The fallback preserves source element identity on reorder
Changed source hash at the same URL invalidates only its media
1440px layout remains within the viewport
390px layout remains within the viewport
Browsing and refresh make no mutation or generation request
Complete shell has no JavaScript exceptions

state_contracts.boundary: Identity/focus pure functions only; actual DOM is tested by the browser driver.

retained_script_contracts.boundary: Existing inert DOM harness uses a markup renderer substitute; policy coverage, not real DOM evidence.

warnings: Expected fault-injection diagnostics are retained in the raw log

introduced_regression.observed: A direct checkbox event changed the live DOM without updating the earlier render signature. Clear selection incorrectly left it checked.
introduced_regression.before_fix: The added expectation failed before live checkbox/class synchronization.
introduced_regression.after_fix: The current browser scenario passes. Main already passes this scenario; it is not a main defect.

browser_requests.other_client: Setup-side writes affect only a temporary SQLite fixture to simulate other-client metadata changes.

hosted_native: Pending actual current-head CI receipt at publication; record its identity separately, do not relabel this local checkpoint.
limits: The number of rendered cards and Workspace payload remain unbounded; no paging, thumbnail or 1000/10000-record benchmark.
No measured heap, network-transfer, GPU, decoder-state or codec/playback benefit is inferred.
The video test is synthetic DOM release; insertBefore fallback preserves element identity and focus, not promised uninterrupted playback.
No owner-PC, installed runtime, screen-reader, actual zoom, native-editor, licensing or artwork acceptance.
Sidebar and collection-control focus are separate owners and are not certified here.
